Name: Rainbow Dash Horse (Content Patcher)
Author: Emfen1
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is my first ever mod; a very simple recolour of the normal horse turning it into Rainbow Dash from My Little Pony (MLP). No manual sprite replacement required; just unzip into the mod folder and play![/color]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Full retexture of all riding and galloping animations.[/*]
[*]Vanilla saddle removed.[/*]
[*]Cool horse with rainbow hair.[/*]
[*]Cutie mark and folded wings.[/*]
[*]Rainbow Dash![/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements [/b][/size]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]


[b][size=4]Credits & Permissions[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Credit to ConcernedApe for the original horse sprite sheet used as a template.[/*]
[*]Rainbow Dash is a character owned by Hasbro. This is a non-profit fan-made tribute.[/*]
[*]Please do not re-upload this mod to other websites without my permission. Only download from the original Nexus page.[/*]
[/list]
